articles.summary: A new benchmarking study comparing PacBio, Illumina, and Oxford Nanopore finds that HiFi sequencing delivers the lowest error rate and highest taxa recovery for environmental metabarcoding. Here's what the results mean for biodiversity and environmental health research.
articles.title: HiFi sequencing sets the benchmark for environmental health metabarcoding

articles.summary: Writing a sequencing grant takes more time than it should. Get curated papers, competitive benchmarks, and budget guidance to build a stronger proposal faster.
articles.title: How to build a more competitive grant proposal without losing your research time to it
